NSCameraUsageDescription: Homezy needs the camera so you can photograph your fridge and your day.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Homezy needs your photos so you can pick fridge and journal pictures from the gallery.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location is only used to show the sky and weather over your home. It is not stored.
NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: We ask so we can show you more relevant ads. If you decline, ads are shown without personalization.
